thread:
sam: Postmortem follow-up: streaming partials/timeouts. Need a compact action tracker and owners.

li: I'll take lead on the short-term client changes (SDK defaults + docs). Goal: make reconnect behavior safer by default.

tess: I'll own the infra guardrail PR to prevent cache thrash during spikes. ETA 5 days.

ana (ops-bot): Created ticket INC-2026-058 and linked logs + traces. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-058

patrick: Observability gap noted: we lack correlated session ids between load balancer and runtime logs. I'll add session_id propagation and a quick dashboard. ETA 48h.

li: Short plan: SDK change exposes RECONNECT_STRATEGY and enables resend-on-reconnect with idempotency token. Example: 
```
stream.connect({ strategy: 'expo-jitter', max: 3000, idempotency: true })
```

sam: Server-side should accept an idempotency token and a reconnect window of 600ms. That prevents duplicate processing if client resends.

tess: Infra plan: add small per-session pin (reserve 2MB) for active streams for 24s to avoid immediate eviction. This is opt-in on heavy sessions.

ana (ops-bot): Added runbook step: when partial responses spike, check reserved-session pressure and lb-retry spikes.

patrick: Dashboard panels to add: partial_response_rate, session_reserve_fill, lb_retry_rate, reconnects_per_min. Also add alert: partial_response_rate > 0.5% for 10m.

li: I'll open the SDK PR today. Tests: simulate eviction during active stream to reproduce partial-response.

tess: Runtime PR will add metric `session_reserve_active` and a warning when reserve exhaustion reaches 80%.

sam: We should separate mitigations: immediate (client + server-window + dashboard) and medium (session reserve + mutex on cache invalidation) and long (smart eviction/compaction).

ana (ops-bot): Pattern match: similar incidents: INC-2025-290, INC-2025-671. Recurrence score 76%.

patrick: Also will add sampling to logs to capture full session traces on partials for 1% of affected sessions.

li: Client default will also reduce aggressive auto-reconnect attempts; new default: base 150ms, cap 2500ms, jitter 30%.

tess: Rollout plan: canary 100 users on reserve feature first, watch `partial_response_rate` and `cpu_usage`. Canary 24h then expand.

sam: Assign owners and deadlines: SDK (li, 2d), server-window (sam/tess, 2d), infra reserve (tess, 5d), observability (patrick, 2d), regression tests (li & patrick, 3d).

ana (ops-bot): Follow-up meeting scheduled in 3 business days at 09:30. Added owner checklist to ticket.

patrick: I'll add the SLO annotation and mark affected customers for potential SLA credits if recurrence happens.

li: I'll include migration notes in the SDK changelog and add a short snippet for partner teams to opt out if needed.

sam: Good. At the sync bring PR links, dashboards, and exact canary gating criteria. Thanks. :thumbsup:
